pbi_title: QC - Insights & Media - 003 D - Private Sector Export Reports

cases.title: Verify that the Private Sector Export Reports page renders hero and quarterly archive section content bilingually with correct English/LTR direction

steps.action: Navigate Main Menu -> Insights & Media -> Private Sector Export Reports (EN)
steps.expected: Page loads at the correct URL
Hero shows eyebrow "Insights & Media", title "Private Sector Export Reports", description text, and illustration image, all LTR-aligned
Section shows eyebrow "Quarterly archive", heading "Find an export report", description, and a search box with placeholder "Search."

Locate the report card in the "October–December 2024" group

cases.title: Verify that an Administrator can perform the full report lifecycle (create, edit, preview, publish, replace, unpublish, delete)

steps.action: Open Object Authoring for Export Report

steps.expected: Every action completes without a permission error at each step

Open Object Authoring for Export Report

steps.expected: Every action completes; report appears Published on the live page

Open Object Authoring for Export Report

cases.title: Verify that a Public Visitor can browse, search, view, and download published reports without authentication

steps.action: Click View Details, then Download on a result
steps.expected: PDF opens online, then downloads to device; no login prompt at any step

steps.action: As an unauthenticated visitor, navigate directly to the Object Authoring Export Report management URL
steps.expected: Access is denied/redirected to login; the report management grid and its data are never rendered to the unauthenticated request

cases.title: Verify that published reports render grouped quarter-wise with the newest reporting quarter first

steps.action: Publish reports in Q4 2024, Q3 2024, Q1 2024, and Q4 2023

steps.expected: Groups appear in order: "October–December 2024", "July–September 2024", "January–March 2024", "October–December 2023"; no "April–June 2024" group present anywhere

cases.title: Verify that Quarter and Reporting Year derive the correct group badge, name and covering period

steps.action: Publish the report with Quarter=Q4, Reporting Year=2024
Inspect the group header for that report
steps.expected: Group shows badge "Q4", name "Fourth quarter", covering period "October–December 2024", all system-derived

cases.title: Verify that Publication Month/Year independently drive the card label while Quarter/Reporting Year drive the group header

steps.action: Confirm the report from the group-header case is Published with Publication Month=February, Publication Year=2025
Compare the group header text against the card label text for the same report
steps.expected: Group header reads "October–December 2024" while the same card's label reads "Q4 · February 2025"; the two values are visibly different and both correct per their own source fields

cases.title: Verify that File Type and File Size are derived automatically from the uploaded PDF, not manually entered

steps.action: In Object Authoring, upload PSER-Q4-2024.pdf (2.4MB) to Report File PDF
steps.expected: Upload accepted; no File Type/File Size input fields presented to the admin

steps.action: Publish and inspect the card meta line
steps.expected: Card meta line shows "PDF • 2.4 MB" automatically, matching the uploaded file's real properties

cases.title: Verify that replacing a report's PDF makes the new file live and supersedes the old one

cases.title: Verify that Unpublish removes a report from the public page

steps.action: On a Published QCTEST- report, click Unpublish

steps.action: Open the public page in a fresh logged-out context

Open the public page in a fresh logged-out context
steps.expected: The report reappears in its correct quarter group with unchanged field values

cases.title: Verify that deleting a report removes it from both the admin grid and the public page
